claims.statement: Tom Allen was one of Jem Mace's seconds in the Mace-Coburn fight at Montgomery Station, Mississippi.
claims.excerpt: Tom McAlpine and Larry Powers are seconds for Coburn ; Cusick and Tom Allen for Mace.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was among the notables of the prize ring present at the Mace-Coburn fight.
claims.excerpt: Among the notables of the prize ring present were Tom. Allen, Ned. O Baldwin

notes: Republic account of the same fight as the Globe-Democrat item 441. Allen was a second, not a fighter, so no fight entry. The hint that Allen travelled on the excursion train is not stated and is dropped.
